name: diagram
description: Generate a Mermaid diagram of the code/architecture.
body: Produce a Mermaid diagram of $ARGUMENTS using the `code-analysis`/`architecture-patterns` skills. Map modules, layers and key data flow from the real code, then output a valid ```mermaid``` flowchart (renders on GitHub). Keep it readable, not exhaustive.

name: env
description: Set up a reproducible dev environment (nix/direnv/devcontainer).
body: Set up a reproducible dev environment for this project per $ARGUMENTS using the `nix-package-manager`/`direnv-envrc`/`env-config-management` skills. Detect the stack, generate the config (flake.nix / .envrc / devcontainer.json), pin versions, and keep secrets out. Explain how to activate it.

name: profile
description: Profile a dataset: schema, stats, missingness, quality.
body: Profile the dataset in $ARGUMENTS using the `data-science-eda`/`data-cleaning` skills. Report schema/dtypes, row/column counts, missingness, distributions and obvious quality issues (duplicates, outliers, encoding). Flag anything that would break downstream modeling.

name: anomaly
description: Detect anomalies/outliers in a dataset or metric.
body: Detect anomalies in $ARGUMENTS using the `anomaly-detection` skill. Account for seasonality/trend, choose an appropriate method, and report flagged points with context and confidence. Avoid false positives from static thresholds.

name: versioning
description: Set up or check dataset/pipeline versioning (DVC).
body: Set up or verify data versioning for $ARGUMENTS using the `data-versioning` skill (DVC). Ensure large files are tracked by DVC not git, pipelines are reproducible (dvc repro), and lineage is intact. Report the state and next steps.

name: notebook
description: Run and validate a scientific notebook reproducibly.
body: Validate the notebook in $ARGUMENTS using the `jupyter-notebooks` skill. Run it top-to-bottom (Restart & Run All) to confirm reproducibility, flag hidden-state/out-of-order issues, and check for committed outputs/secrets. Report what actually ran.

name: tasks
description: Discover and run project tasks (just/make/npm scripts).
body: Discover the project's task runner (justfile / Makefile / package.json scripts / Taskfile) using the `just-task-runner`/`build-tool-make` skills. List available tasks and, if one is named in $ARGUMENTS, run it and report the result.

name: scaffold
description: Scaffold a new service from a golden-path template.
body: Scaffold a new service named per $ARGUMENTS using the `platform-engineering`/`project-scaffolding` skills. Follow the org's golden path if one exists (templates, CI, ownership metadata, observability). Otherwise set up a conventional, tested, CI-wired service. Report what was created.

name: mutation
description: Run mutation testing to assess test quality.
body: Run mutation testing for $ARGUMENTS using the `mutation-testing` skill (Stryker/mutmut/PIT). Focus on critical modules, report surviving mutants (weak tests) and suggest stronger assertions. Note it can be slow — scope it.

name: property
description: Add property-based tests for logic with many edge cases.
body: Add property-based tests for $ARGUMENTS using the `property-testing` skill (Hypothesis/fast-check/QuickCheck). Identify invariants, write generators covering the input space, and run them (with shrinking). Verify they actually exercise edge cases.

name: reverse
description: Defensive triage of a binary/artifact (authorized only).
body: Do a defensive triage of the artifact in $ARGUMENTS for security review (authorized/owned artifacts only). Inspect type, strings, imports, and obvious indicators using standard tools. Report findings for defense; do not produce offensive tooling or work on artifacts you're not authorized to analyze.

name: gis-inspect
description: Inspect geospatial data: CRS, extent, bands, layers.
body: Inspect the geospatial file in $ARGUMENTS using the `gis-geospatial` skill. Detect gdal/ogr, report CRS/projection, extent, resolution/bands (raster) or geometry/fields (vector), and flag CRS mismatches or missing overviews. Read-only.
